The Austria-Hungary keyframes 1880/1900/1905 correctly omit Bosnia and austria-hungary/ledger/2 and /4 record the occupation (page: Bosnia 'nominally remain under sovereignty of the Ottoman Empire'; occupation 29 July 1878; annexation announced 5 October 1908). Keeping Bosnia in the Austrian keyframe would draw it as plain Austrian land, not hatched. The grey comes from the Ottoman dossier (not owned): its keyframes 1880, 1885, 1895, 1900, 1905 are 'ok' on Cliopatria shapes without Bosnia, so each snaps the Ottoman-held, Austria-occupied land to nobody, and ottoman-empire/ledger/196 books a 1878 loss instead of an occupation. See handoffs.
